joint.title: Joint generation
joint.description: RGB views with depth, edges and segmentation across the same scene.

newview.title: Cross-view completion
newview.description: Generate complementary wrist views conditioned on the observed main-view video.

c2v.title: Modality-conditioned generation
c2v.description: Generate RGB videos conditioned on a depth, edge or segmentation video.

v2c.title: Visual modality prediction
v2c.description: Predict depth, edges or segmentation conditioned on observed RGB videos.

cases.title: Example 079
cases.prompt: A robotic arm removes a white plate from a dish rack and sets it flat on the table. It then picks up a red pomegranate and places it gently onto the center of the white plate.

cases.title: Example 043
cases.prompt: A dual-arm robot sits at a wooden table with a glass jug and brown cup. The left arm grasps the jug handle, tilts it to pour liquid into the cup, then places it back down smoothly.

cases.title: Example 014
cases.prompt: The robot arm opens the rice cooker's lid, presses its off-white button, and closes the lid—executing a precise shutdown sequence on the white appliance with orange handle. The motion is smooth and focused, occurring on a tiled workbench marked with blue grid lines.

cases.title: Example 032
cases.prompt: A dual-arm robot inserts a red RAM module into a motherboard on a white table. The left arm grasps and aligns the module while the right arm assists in seating it securely.

cases.title: Example 037
cases.prompt: A dual-arm robot sits at a kitchen counter with a black microwave and various items nearby. The left arm picks up a brown cloth, wipes the top of the microwave, then places the cloth back on the counter.

cases.title: Example 066
cases.prompt: A robotic arm retrieves two slices of toasted bread from a white toaster on a tiled kitchen counter. It places each slice sequentially onto a blue oval plate positioned to the left of the appliance.

cases.title: Example 057
cases.prompt: A dual-arm robot holds a brass gong steady with its left gripper while repeatedly striking it with a red-tasseled mallet in its right gripper. The motion is precise and rhythmic against an indoor exhibition backdrop.

cases.title: Example 064
cases.prompt: A dual-arm robot stands before a stocked snack shelf with a wire cart below. The right arm reaches out, grasps a white Pom's Life bag, and deposits it into the cart while the left arm stays still.

cases.title: Example 073
cases.prompt: A dual-arm robot uses its right arm to pick up a green eraser from a table stand. It wipes blue writing off a whiteboard with smooth sweeping motions, then returns the eraser to its original spot.

cases.title: Example 048
cases.prompt: A dual-arm robot picks green snack packages from a store shelf and places them into a cardboard box on a shopping cart. Motions are smooth and deliberate, with accurate grasping and gentle release.

cases.title: Example 015
cases.prompt: edge video condition. A robotic arm reaches for a yellow banana on a white table, grasps it, lifts it, and places it into a woven wicker basket positioned on the left side of the table.

cases.title: Example 019
cases.prompt: segmentation video condition. A robotic arm picks up a black marker from a white cloth-covered table and places it into a green panda-shaped pen holder. The motion is smooth and deliberate, with no interaction involving the nearby dark bottle.

cases.title: Example 004
cases.prompt: edge video condition. A dual-arm robot approaches a beige curtain and uses both grippers to untie the fabric tieback. It then pulls the curtain sideways to open it before releasing and retracting.

cases.title: Example 009
cases.prompt: segmentation video condition. The robot arm moves toward a white coffee dispenser, grasps a black cup from the table, lifts it, positions it beneath the dispenser, and fills it with dark coffee before withdrawing it.

cases.title: Example 005
cases.prompt: depth video condition. A dual-arm robot operates in a room with wooden tables. The right arm grasps and rotates a black circular handle on a floor device while the left arm stays still.

cases.title: Example 013
cases.prompt: depth video condition. The robot arm grasps a water bottle, lifts it smoothly, and pours water into an empty yellow plastic cup before returning the bottle to its original position. It then moves toward a black metal mug and picks up the now-filled yellow cup.
